data.body: **P2:** `closing` is not set until `ExecutionManager.close()`, but `DurableExecutor` constructs `InvocationEndInfo` and calls `onInvocationEnd` before that close. An admitted continuation can pass this check and then run another predicate/checkpoint during or after plugin finalization, causing lifecycle events to occur after the end hook and omitting completed work from its snapshot. Add a pre-finalization barrier that closes admission and drains continuations/running handlers before constructing `InvocationEndInfo`; invoke plugins only after that barrier, then shut down checkpointing.
